examples.title: Flight of the Fjord  One of the most beautiful landscapes I have ever seen with my own eyes. Just stunning! This flight was above the world famous Geirangerfjord, part of the West Norwegian Fjords UNESCO World Heritage site and the only natural UNESCO site in all of Norway. Conditions were relatively good with a slight tailwind up top, which meant we had to be careful on the exit. The flight itself was incredible. I'll be dreaming about that flatter rocky terrain for years to come, then punching through the small cloud before landing in a beautiful grassy field. This jump really had it all!

Somewhere in New York that feels like a movie 🏡 Quiet streets, beautiful homes, and so much greenery — a completely different side of NYC. Located in Forest Hills, Queens, this charming neighborhood is only about 30 minutes from Manhattan. Take the E or F train to Forest Hills–71st Ave, then walk toward Station Square to explore these beautiful residential streets. Lake Como is one of those places that somehow feels even more beautiful in real life. 🇮🇹✨ Between historic villas, quiet lakeside villages, mountain views and peaceful boat rides, every corner feels cinematic without even trying. From Bellagio to Varenna, Menaggio to hidden spots like Lierna and Nesso, the atmosphere here is what makes people fall in love with Northern Italy. 🌿🌊 What I love most about Lake Como is that it can feel luxurious and relaxing at the same time. One moment you’re walking through elegant gardens and historic streets, the next you’re simply sitting by the water watching the boats pass slowly across the lake. It’s not just a destination — it’s a whole atmosphere. And honestly, one of the most timeless places to experience in Italy. ☀️ #LakeComo #LagoDiComo #ItalyTravel #NorthernItaly #BeautifulDestinations
